source: Integrating lead clarification and independent challenger; before any paired fidelity outcomes
clarification: Useful disease-specific RNA comparisons may be valid and valuable without protein or clinical validation. Orthogonal/replicate identity/assay controls are claim-dependent, not a universal endpoint prerequisite. The precise current obstacle is no authenticated released same-donor tumor/culture transcriptional bridge with interpretable controls. No RNA/fidelity biological failure is inferred.
prior_context_precision: R8 fixed culture RNA panels/context were descriptively evaluated in some lanes. The donor-paired model-fidelity comparison was not executed or authenticated. R8 microenvironment fixed13-gene culture-context freeze is distinct; no blanket assertion all culture expression was unexecuted. No prior panel/chemokine/IR/APA rescue.
one_pair: Two independent donor systems are needed for the frozen general donor-fidelity interpretation, not every possible narrowly useful RNA claim. A credible one-pair RNA finding can be evaluated at its actual scope; none is source-authenticated here.
alternative: An unpaired, assay-compatible culture-versus-primary-tumor RNA comparison could be separately useful with prespecified meaningful features, matched non-EMC culture/tumor controls and mixture/batch/handling sensitivity. It is not paired fidelity and requires separate prospective source/value/coverage review; no new panel or values proposed now.
